scope: Deterministic recurrence calendar, stable slot ordinal and version-policy expectations shared with the future Android client. Nothing here is a claim about the original APK, U03, Android Room/WorkManager, or full M3.

languageStatus.rustBackend: implemented; calendar vectors asserted by unit tests
languageStatus.android: not implemented in this task; vectors are a read-only reference for later Room/WorkManager work

rules.logicalSlot: stable monotonic nonnegative plan ordinal; independent of ruleRevision, device and retry
rules.planAnchor: immutable startLocalDateTime supplies the clock time for every occurrence
rules.monthEndClamp: a selector past the month length clamps to the last day of that month and never moves the anchor
rules.calendarDedup: within one calendar period two selectors that clamp to the same actual date produce one occurrence
rules.endInclusive: endAt is inclusive; the first occurrence strictly after endAt ends the plan
rules.countOrEnd: maxCount and endAt stop the plan on the first boundary reached
rules.timezoneResolution: resolved by PostgreSQL 17 timestamp-without-time-zone AT TIME ZONE: fall-back ambiguity takes the offset after the transition, spring-forward gap takes the offset before the transition
